docs.title: My Docs
docs.text: Welcome to My Docs 👋 This documentation provides a quick overview of the project, how to get started, and where to find important information.

docs.title: 🚀 What is This Project?
docs.text:
This is a demo documentation site built using MkDocs and deployed via GitHub Pages.

It is designed to be: - Easy to read - Simple to maintain - Fast to deploy

docs.title: 🛠️ Tech Stack
docs.text:
This documentation is built using:

  • MkDocs
  • Markdown
  • Material for MkDocs
  • GitHub Pages
